The datasheet defines one part (SO-QSFP28-CWDM4) with four CWDM lanes; wavelength min/max/center are paired per lane in the technical table. Per-lane specs use 25.78 Gbps and +2.5 dBm max per lane; aggregate 103.12 Gbps and +8.5 dBm total are module-level and not tied to a single lane row. No per-mode penalties were supplied; optical path penalty is global.
